## [1.5.0](https://github.com/neoKushan/smortthings/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0) (2026-11-27)

### ✨ New Features

* experimental "Install alongside SmartThings" side-by-side patch ([6ae6a2d](https://github.com/neoKushan/smortthings/commit/6ae6a2dbea9a4eb999924ca23db3893113570676))

patches.name: Allow install on Samsung phones
patches.description: Removes duplicate permission declarations that block installing the patched app on Samsung phones (INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION). Enable this only if the install fails on a Samsung device; it is unnecessary on non-Samsung phones.

patches.name: Install alongside SmartThings (experimental)
patches.description: EXPERIMENTAL — opt-in. Installs the patched app next to the stock SmartThings so you keep the official app (for SmartTag etc.) and use this copy only to read a device's LocalThings OwnerPSK. Renames the application id, launcher name/icon, process identity and the in-dex provider authorities so the clone installs, launches, signs in and syncs devices alongside stock. The device control web-plugin may not work on non-Samsung phones; read the key from the device's Edit screen (long-press the device -> Edit). Please report results.

options.description: The application id for the renamed copy so it installs next to stock SmartThings. Must be a valid, unused Android package name.
The launcher name shown for the renamed copy, so it is distinguishable from stock SmartThings on the home screen.

patches.name: LocalThings Owner PSK in device settings
patches.description: Shows a device's OwnerPSK (for Home Assistant LocalThings) on its Edit screen, extracted locally via the app's own key store. Tested on HW-Q950A / SmartThings 1.8.54.23, 1.8.52.23.

patches.name: Use web login on Samsung phones
patches.description: Lets the re-signed app sign in and open devices on a Samsung phone: forces the non-Samsung web Samsung Account login and skips Samsung signature-protected calls the re-signed app can't make. Enable it alongside "Allow install on Samsung phones" if login fails or devices crash on open. Unnecessary on non-Samsung phones.
